name: War Domain
label: Divine Domain
summary: A holy warrior with bonus-action attacks, divine accuracy, and heavy armor.
flavor: War has many manifestations, and the gods of war watch over them all. Their clerics excel in battle, inspiring others to fight the good fight or supporting soldiers with divine might.
playstyle: The best melee cleric. War Priest gives you a free bonus-action attack every round, and Guided Strike turns a near-miss into a hit at a crucial moment.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: War Priest
features.description: When you use the Attack action, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action. You can do this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once) per long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
features.description: When you make an attack roll, you can use Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll. You can do so after you see the roll but before the DM says whether it hits.

features.name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing
features.description: When a creature within 30 feet makes an attack roll, you can use your reaction to grant that creature a +10 bonus to the roll, using your Channel Divinity.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 damage of the same type dealt by the weapon. This increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.description: You gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
